TRAINING.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Write the instructions for this section…
TRAINING.EMPTY: No sections yet. Add the first one, for example ROL.
TRAINING.ROUTE_TAG_MISSING: This label does not exist in the account.
TRAINING.ROUTE_PHRASES: Customer phrases (this is what picks the route)
TRAINING.ROUTE_PHRASES_PLACEHOLDER: how much is it, pricing, i want a quote
TRAINING.ROUTE_DOES_NOTHING: It queries nothing and has nothing to do when it cannot solve: it answers only from the Training and may make up prices or schedules. If that is intended (greeting, asking for data), leave it.
TRAINING.ROUTE_UNKNOWN: %{value} — does not exist in this account
TRAINING.ROUTE_MODAL_HINT: A route is a topic the agent handles: which phrases pick it, where the answer comes from and what it does if it does not resolve.
TRAINING.ROUTE_NAME_TAKEN: There is already a route named "%{name}". For the engine only one exists: it keeps the first and the other is never picked.
TRAINING.ROUTE_NO_PHRASES: Without customer phrases this route will almost never be picked: it is the only thing the engine uses to decide.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE: What this route handles, in the agent's words
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE_PLACEHOLDER: answers pricing questions and quotes from the current list
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE_HINT: It goes as one line in the ALCANCE POR RAMA section, which is what the agent reads to know what it talks about in this topic. You can leave it empty and write it later.
TRAINING.ROUTE_AS_DEFAULT: This is the default route: messages that match no other one go here
TRAINING.ROUTE_DELETE_CONFIRM: Remove the route and its scope line
TRAINING.SECTION_MODAL_HINT: Sections are the instructions the agent reads, in the order they are written.
TRAINING.SECTION_MODAL_PREAMBLE: The leading text goes before the first section and has no label.
TRAINING.SECTION_NAME_TAKEN: There is already a section with that name. Two identical labels confuse the agent: it cannot tell which one applies.
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_TITLE: Routes that already exist in this account
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_HINT: Copy a route from another agent, with its phrases, source and scope. You can edit it afterwards.
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_SEARCH: Search by name, phrases, source or agent…
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_EMPTY: No routes written in any agent of this account yet.
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_TITLE: Sections that already exist in this account
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_HINT: Copy a whole section from another agent, with its text. You can edit it afterwards. The same name may appear several times: those are the different ways it is written.
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_SEARCH: Search by name, content or agent…
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_EMPTY: No sections written in any agent of this account yet.
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_ALL_TAKEN: This agent already has every route written in the account.
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_ALL_TAKEN: This agent already has every section written in the account.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SOURCE_MISSING: This source does not exist in the account: the route will find nothing.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SOURCE_ADDED: Source added. This route can use it now.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SOURCE_ADD_ERROR: The source could not be added. Check the data and try again.
TRAINING.ROUTE_INTEGRATION_MISSING: @discourse uses the channel's Discourse integration, and the selected channel does not have it connected: the route will find nothing.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE_GENERATE_ERROR: It could not be generated. Try again or write it by hand.
